title: Lilac & Blue Petal Arch
desc: An outdoor wooden triangle arch draped with white sheer, dressed in lilac, white and yellow with soft trailing greens.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The lilac-white-yellow mix crowning the triangle arch.

items.role: Lilac hydrangea clusters at the arch top and corners (soft lilac tone matching the scene).
White hydrangea heads massed at the centre crown.
White larkspur spikes rising through the crown (white larkspur/lily forms in the scene).

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Yellow orchids and small white faces along the arch and ground line.

items.role: Yellow oncidium (dancing orchid) sprays arching out of the top greenery.
Small white daisies scattered through the ground line plantings.
White pompon mums adding rounded white faces along the aisle edges.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: The soft feathery greens filling the arch frame.

items.role: Fountain grass plumes softening the arrangement edges.
Fine soft trailing grasses hanging over the arch line.
Dark green pine spray giving needle texture inside the mix.
Eucalyptus sprigs through the mid layer.
Long fine yellow-green drooping stems cascading over the arch (form-match for the yellow-green trailing pine foliage — true drooping pine is a logged gap).
